briefdescription.para: A generic VPValue, like live-in values or defined by a recipe that defines multiple values.

simplesect.para: an ID for the concrete type of this object. This is used to implement the classof checks. This should not be used for any other purpose, as the values may change as LLVM evolves.

Remove a single User from the list of users.
Returns true if the value has more than one unique user.
